description: 프롬프트 v4.5 측정(#114) 문항. eval_questions_v1.json과 같은 형식. 입력값 질문(category input) 2개, 열린 조언 질문(category open) 3개, 상품 질문(category product) 1개. 채점은 scripts/_v45_check.py(v45Check). 기대 숫자·고른 목표는 문항에 적지 않고, 측정 때 읽은 INT-06(행의 toolResult: declaredCommitments·goals)에서 정한다(목표 조합은 실행마다 DB로 바꾼다). 설계: specs/chat/chat_v45_measure_v1.md.

questions.text: How much money do I have left each month after my expenses?
How much do I spend each month on fixed living costs, sending money home and other spending?
What should I focus on with my money right now?
Can you give me some financial advice?
What should I do next to get closer to my goals?
Recommend a savings product for me
